question: What is the difference in the volume (in cm³) of a sphere of radius 7 cm and that of a cone of radius 7 cm and height 10 cm? (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the sphere = 7 cm

The radius of the cone = 7 cm

The height of the cone = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a sphere = (4/3) × π × (Radius)³

The volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × (Radius)² × Height

**Calculation:**

The difference in volume = [(4/3) × π × 73] - [(1/3) × π × 72 × 10]

= [(4/3) × (22/7) × 343] - [(1/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 10]

= [(7 × 22)/3] (28 - 10)

= (154/3) × 18

= 924 cm3

**∴ The difference in the volume (in cm3) is 924 cm3**
